name: Avilyn Grace
bio: Avilyn Grace blends soulful vocals with modern R&B and indie pop production. Her AI-assisted compositions explore themes of late nights, urban emotion, and quiet vulnerability.

name: Dem Bois
bio: Dem Bois bring raw energy and authentic street storytelling to every track. From hard-hitting Trap to soulful Boom Bap, their music hits different every time.
